summary: Phase 02.5 Pre-Registration complete. Formal pre-registration document (planning/preregistration.md) locked with exactly 1 primary metric (Criterion 1: Sharp escape step-function, k >= 15.0 with separation bounds), 2 secondary confirmatory metrics (Criterion 2: Late-onset recovery >= 90%, Criterion 3: Supercritical TOST parity within +-2.5%), 4 exploratory metrics, 5 objective data exclusion criteria, N=30 seeds/cell power calibration (SE <= 0.091), and a 3-way decision rule. Bidirectional linkages to ADR-003 and P03_GATE.md established. Pending PI approval.
